<!doctype html>
<html lang="tr"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow"><meta name="theme-color" content="#0b1730">
<title>Yönetim Paneli · OnlineKaydet</title>
<style>
:root{--ink:#00265b;--ink2:#0a3470;--blue:#00265b;--blue-s:#e8eef7;--paper:#f4f5f7;--card:#fff;--line:#dde1e8;--tx:#141a24;--mut:#667085;--ok:#16794a;--ok-s:#e3f4ea;--warn:#a45a06;--warn-s:#fdf1dc;--bad:#b42318;--bad-s:#fde8e5;--r:6px}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
body{font-family:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;color:var(--tx);background:var(--paper);font-size:14px;line-height:1.45;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:2px}
.num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
svg.i{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.75;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none}
.app{display:grid;grid-template-columns:216px 1fr;min-height:100vh}
.rail{background:var(--ink);color:#c9d3e6;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:18px 12px;position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh}
.rail .logo{padding:4px 8px 18px}.rail .logo img{height:26px;display:block}
.rail a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:10px;border-radius:8px;color:#c9d3e6;text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;font-size:14.5px;margin-bottom:2px;min-height:40px}
.rail a:hover{background:#14244a}.rail a.on{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);font-weight:650}
.rail a .bd{margin-left:auto;background:#f4b740;color:#3a2700;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;border-radius:20px;padding:1px 7px}
.rail .firm{margin-top:auto;border-top:1px solid #22345c;padding:14px 8px 2px;font-size:12.5px;color:#8fa0c2}
.rail .firm b{display:block;color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.rail .firm button{background:none;border:0;color:#8fa0c2;padding:6px 0 0;text-decoration:underline;font-size:12.5px}
main{padding:26px 32px 40px;min-width:0}
.top{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:10px;margin-bottom:22px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.top h1{font-size:25px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em}.top p{color:var(--mut);margin-top:2px}.top .sp{flex:1}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:40px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;font-weight:600;color:var(--tx);white-space:nowrap}
.btn:hover{border-color:#c9c5b8}.btn.p{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:#fff}.btn.p:hover{background:#0e47ad}
.btn.s{min-height:34px;padding:0 11px;font-size:13px}.btn.d{color:var(--bad)}.btn[disabled]{opacity:.55;cursor:default}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r)}
.card h2{font-size:15px;font-weight:650}
.card .hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:15px 18px 10px}.pv .hd{flex-wrap:wrap;row-gap:8px}.card .hd .sp{flex:1}.card .hd a,.lnk{color:var(--blue);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;text-decoration:none;background:none;border:0;padding:0;cursor:pointer}
.pad{padding:0 18px 16px}
.figs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);background:#fff;margin-bottom:18px}
.fig{padding:16px 20px;border-left:1px solid var(--line)}.fig:first-child{border-left:0}
.fig small{color:var(--mut);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500}.fig b{display:block;font-size:26px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-top:2px}.fig span{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 340px;gap:18px;align-items:start}
.row{display:grid;align-items:center;padding:11px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);gap:12px}
.row .t{font-weight:650;font-size:15px}.row .m{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px}
.tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:20px;white-space:nowrap}
.tag:before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}
.tag.w{background:#eef0f4;color:#475467}.tag.g{background:var(--ok-s);color:var(--ok)}.tag.b{background:var(--blue-s);color:var(--blue)}.tag.y{background:var(--warn-s);color:var(--warn)}.tag.r{background:var(--bad-s);color:var(--bad)}
.av{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;flex:none}
.bar{height:8px;border-radius:8px;background:#eceae3;overflow:hidden}.bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--blue);border-radius:8px}
.note{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}.empty{padding:22px 18px;color:var(--mut);text-align:center}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}
th{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut);text-align:left;padding:9px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:#faf9f6;white-space:nowrap}
td{padding:11px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:middle}
td.r,th.r{text-align:right}.tw{overflow-x:auto}
.seg{display:inline-flex;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:#fff;overflow:hidden}
.seg button{padding:0 14px;min-height:38px;border:0;background:none;font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--mut)}.seg button.on{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
/* liste / süzgeç */
.fbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:12px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.fbar input[type=search],.fbar select,.fbar input[type=date]{border:1px solid #d0d5dd;border-radius:8px;padding:0 11px;min-height:38px;background:#fff;font:inherit;color:var(--tx)}
.fbar input[type=search]{flex:1 1 220px}
.fbar .chips{margin:0}.sumline{padding:10px 18px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut);border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.chip small{font-weight:500;opacity:.75;margin-left:3px}
.stt{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(110px,1fr));gap:8px;margin:2px 0 14px}.stt div{background:#faf9f6;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 11px}.stt small{display:block;color:var(--mut);font-size:12px}.stt b{font-size:16px}
.sug{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;margin-top:-8px;margin-bottom:12px;overflow:hidden}.sug button{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;width:100%;text-align:left;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;padding:9px 12px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.sug button:first-child{border-top:0}.sug button:hover{background:var(--blue-s)}
.steps{display:flex;gap:4px;margin:0 0 14px}.steps i{flex:1;height:5px;border-radius:5px;background:#e4e7ec}.steps i.on{background:var(--blue)}
/* takvim */
.calw{overflow:auto}
.cal{display:grid;min-width:640px}
.cal .ch{padding:12px;border-left:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-weight:650;background:#fff;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:3}
.cal .ch small{display:block;font-weight:500;color:var(--mut);font-size:12px}
.cal .hours div{font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);text-align:right;padding:0 8px;transform:translateY(-8px)}.cal .hours div:first-child{transform:none;padding-top:2px}
.cal .col{position:relative;border-left:1px solid var(--line);cursor:pointer}
.cal .col.off{background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#f3f2ee 0 8px,#faf9f6 8px 16px);cursor:default}
.ev{position:absolute;left:4px;right:4px;border-radius:7px;padding:3px 8px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.3;overflow:hidden;border-left:3px solid;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;border-top:0;border-right:0;border-bottom:0;z-index:1}
.ev b{display:block;font-size:13px}
.ev.r{background:var(--bad-s);border-color:var(--bad)}.ev.w{background:#f1f2f5;border-color:#98a2b3}.ev.b{background:var(--blue-s);border-color:var(--blue)}.ev.g{background:var(--ok-s);border-color:var(--ok)}.ev.y{background:var(--warn-s);border-color:#d98a12}
.now{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:var(--bad);z-index:2;pointer-events:none}
/* form */
label.f{display:block;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut);margin-bottom:12px}
label.f>input,label.f>select,label.f>textarea{display:block;width:100%;margin-top:4px;border:1px solid #d0d5dd;border-radius:8px;padding:9px 11px;min-height:40px;background:#fff;color:var(--tx);font-weight:400;font-size:15px}
label.f>textarea{min-height:70px;resize:vertical}
.g2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0 12px}.g3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:0 12px}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin:4px 0 12px}
.chip{border:1px solid #d0d5dd;background:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:7px 12px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;min-height:36px}
.chip.on{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.sw{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #d0d5dd;padding:0}.sw.on{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--ink)}
/* modal */
#ov{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(11,23,48,.5);display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:4vh 14px;overflow:auto;z-index:50}
.md{background:#fff;border-radius:14px;width:100%;max-width:520px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.md.wide{max-width:720px}
.md .mh{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:16px 20px 6px}.md .mh h3{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;flex:1}.md .mh button{border:0;background:none;font-size:24px;line-height:1;color:var(--mut);width:40px;height:40px}
.md .mb{padding:8px 20px 20px}.md .mf{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:6px}
.g2 .w2{grid-column:1/-1}.dgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px 16px}.dr small{display:block;color:var(--mut);font-size:12px;margin-bottom:2px}.dr b{font-weight:600}
.kv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px 1fr;gap:6px 12px;margin:8px 0 14px}.kv dt{color:var(--mut)}.kv dd{margin:0;font-weight:600}
#toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:120px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:11px 18px;border-radius:6px;z-index:80;font-weight:600;max-width:90vw}
#toast.bad{background:var(--bad)}
/* e-ticaret: ürün, sipariş, kampanya */
/* açma kapama anahtarı */
.sw2{position:relative;display:inline-block;width:38px;height:22px;flex:none}
.sw2 input{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;cursor:pointer;z-index:2}
.sw2 i{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:22px;background:#d0d5dd;transition:background .15s;display:block}
.sw2 i:after{content:"";position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;transition:left .15s}
.sw2 input:checked + i{background:var(--blue)}
.sw2 input:checked + i:after{left:18px}
.smsph .bub{max-width:100%}
.md .smsph{margin-top:4px}
.md .cols{display:grid;gap:14px;min-width:0}
.md .cols>*{min-width:0}
.rpw{display:grid;grid-template-columns:230px 1fr;gap:18px;align-items:start}
.rpl{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}
.rpl .gh{padding:9px 14px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;
 color:var(--mut);background:#faf9f6;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.rpl .ri{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;font:inherit;padding:10px 14px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
 cursor:pointer;background:#fff}
.rpl .ri:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.rpl .ri b{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:620}
.rpl .ri small{display:block;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:2px;line-height:1.35}
.rpl .ri.on{background:var(--blue-s);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--blue)}
.rph{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.rph select,.rph input{min-height:36px}
.rph input[type=date]{width:150px}
.gr2b{height:210px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;background:#fff;padding:14px 16px 26px;
 margin-bottom:16px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:8px;overflow:hidden}
.gr2b .bar{flex:1;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--blue),#1f4fa8);border-radius:5px 5px 0 0;position:relative;min-width:8px}
.gr2b .bar span{position:absolute;bottom:-19px;left:-4px;right:-4px;text-align:center;font-size:10px;color:var(--mut);
 white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden}
.gr2b .bar i{position:absolute;top:-17px;left:-8px;right:-8px;text-align:center;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:650;font-style:normal}
.yorum{background:#faf9f6;border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:3px solid var(--blue);border-radius:6px;
 padding:11px 13px;font-size:13px;color:#3a4254;line-height:1.55;margin-top:12px}
.imza{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;background:#fff;overflow:hidden}
.imza .pad2{display:block;width:100%;height:168px;touch-action:none;cursor:crosshair;
 background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,#fff,#fff 27px,#f4f2ed 27px,#f4f2ed 28px)}
.imza .ft5{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;padding:10px 13px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:#faf9f6;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tkt{display:grid;gap:9px}
.tkt .k{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;background:#fff;padding:13px 15px;display:grid;
 grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:center;cursor:pointer}
.tkt .k:hover{border-color:var(--blue)}
.tkt .k.acik2{border-left:3px solid var(--or,#c2410c)}
.tkt .k b{display:block;font-size:14px;font-weight:650}
.tkt .k .mt{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;margin-top:5px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);flex-wrap:wrap}
.tkt .no2{font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut)}
.msg2{display:grid;gap:11px;max-height:46vh;overflow:auto}
.msg2 .m{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start}
.msg2 .m .av3{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;
 font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;background:#e9e7df;color:#6b6457}
.msg2 .m.dk .av3{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.msg2 .bl{background:#faf9f6;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;border-top-left-radius:3px;
 padding:10px 12px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;flex:1;min-width:0}
.msg2 .m.dk .bl{background:var(--blue-s);border-color:#cfdcf7}
.msg2 .bl .zm{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:6px}
.sshot{display:flex;gap:7px;margin-top:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sshot img{width:62px;height:44px;border-radius:7px;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid var(--line);display:block}
.drop{border:1.5px dashed var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:16px;text-align:center;color:var(--mut);
 font-size:13px;background:#fff;cursor:pointer;margin-top:11px}
.drop:hover,.drop.on{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue)}
.drop b{display:block;color:var(--tx);font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:3px}
.ictab{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px}
.ictab .c{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:12px 13px;text-align:left;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.ictab .c b{display:block;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:650}
.ictab .c small{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:3px;line-height:1.4}
.ictab .c .ln3{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:9px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ictab .c.on{border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--blue)}
.ictab .c .bek{background:var(--warn-s);color:#8a5a20;border-radius:20px;padding:1px 8px;font-size:11.5px}
.ic{display:grid;gap:9px}
.ic .r4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:24px 1fr auto auto;gap:11px;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);
 border-radius:6px;background:#fff;padding:12px 13px}
.ic .r4.bek2{border-color:#f0dcc4;background:#fffdf8}
.ic .gr2{color:#c6c1b6;cursor:grab;font-size:15px;line-height:1;user-select:none}
.ic b{display:block;font-size:14px;font-weight:650;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.ic .sub2{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:3px;line-height:1.5}
.ic .meta2{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;margin-top:8px;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);flex-wrap:wrap}
.ic .ac3{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.ic .ph2{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:6px;object-fit:cover;background:#e9e7df}
.bosluk{border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:26px;text-align:center;color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px;background:#fff}
.bosluk b{display:block;font-size:15px;color:var(--tx);margin-bottom:5px}
.nrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 330px;gap:16px;align-items:start}
.nlist .n{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;background:#fff;padding:13px 15px;margin-bottom:10px}
.nlist .n .t4{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:11px}
.nlist .n b{display:block;font-size:14px;font-weight:650}
.nlist .n small{display:block;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:2px}
.nlist .n .msg{background:#faf9f6;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:9px 11px;
 font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;color:#3a4254;margin-top:10px;font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;white-space:pre-wrap}
.nlist .n .ft3{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-top:9px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);flex-wrap:wrap}
.kan{display:inline-flex;gap:4px}
.kan span{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px;padding:2px 7px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut)}
.kan span.on{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-color:var(--ink)}
.smsb{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut)}
.smsb i{font-style:normal;background:#faf9f6;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:1px 7px;color:var(--tx)}
.smsb.uni i{background:var(--warn-s);border-color:#f0dcc4;color:#8a5a20}
.sms2{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;background:#fff;padding:14px 15px}
.smsph{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:13px;background:#faf9f6}
.bub{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;border-bottom-left-radius:4px;
 padding:10px 12px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;color:#1f2733}
.frm{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:600}
.tip2{background:var(--warn-s);border:1px solid #f0dcc4;border-radius:6px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:12.5px;
 color:#7a5218;line-height:1.5;margin-top:11px}
.varl{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.varl .vr{border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:7px;padding:4px 9px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);
 font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;background:#fff;cursor:pointer}
.varl .vr:hover{border-style:solid;border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue)}
.rh{margin-bottom:14px;padding:16px}
.rhh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start}.rhh b{font-size:16px}.rhh small{display:block;color:var(--mut);margin-top:2px;font-size:13px}
.rhb{height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:#e8edf5;margin:12px 0 8px;overflow:hidden}.rhb i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--ok);border-radius:3px;transition:width .3s}
.rhl{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}.rhl li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);min-height:48px}.rhl li:first-child{border-top:0}
.rhd{flex:none;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #c6cfdd;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff}.rhl li.ok .rhd{background:var(--ok);border-color:var(--ok)}.rhl li.ok .rhd svg{width:14px;height:14px}

function yildiz(n){n=+n||0;var s='';for(var i=1;i<=5;i++)s+=i<=n?'★':'☆';return s}
function icOzet(t,r){
 var cols=t.fields.filter(function(f){return f.col});
 var bas=cols[0]?r[cols[0].key]:'';
 var alt=cols.slice(1).map(function(f){
  if(f.type==='puan')return yildiz(r[f.key]);
  if(f.type==='num')return r[f.key]?tl(r[f.key]):'';
  return r[f.key]||''}).filter(Boolean);
 return {bas:bas||'(başlıksız)',alt:alt};}

 if(!CUR.icrows.length){el.innerHTML='<div class="bosluk"><b>'+esc(t.name)+'</b>'+esc(t.empty||'Henüz kayıt yok.')+'</div>';return}
 el.innerHTML='<div class="ic">'+CUR.icrows.map(function(r2){
  var o=icOzet(t,r2),bek=r2.state==='onay';

   +(bek?'<button class="btn s" data-a="ic-karar" data-v="red" data-id="'+esc(r2.id)+'">Reddet</button>'
        +'<button class="btn s p" data-a="ic-karar" data-v="onay" data-id="'+esc(r2.id)+'">Onayla</button>'

   +'</div></div>'}).join('')+'</div>'};
function icAlan(f,v){
 var ad='name="'+f.key+'"',ph=f.hint?' placeholder="'+esc(f.hint)+'"':'';
 if(f.type==='area')return '<textarea '+ad+' rows="4"'+ph+'>'+esc(v||'')+'</textarea>';
 if(f.type==='sel')return '<select '+ad+'><option value="">Seçin</option>'
  +f.options.map(function(o){return '<option'+(o===v?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(o)+'</option>'}).join('')+'</select>';
 if(f.type==='puan')return '<select '+ad+'>'+[5,4,3,2,1].map(function(n){
  return '<option value="'+n+'"'+(+v===n?' selected':'')+'>'+yildiz(n)+' ('+n+')</option>'}).join('')+'</select>';
 if(f.type==='date')return '<input type="date" '+ad+' value="'+esc(v||'')+'">';
 if(f.type==='num')return '<input type="number" step="0.01" '+ad+' value="'+esc(v==null?'':v)+'"'+ph+'>';
 if(f.type==='imgs')return '<textarea '+ad+' rows="3" placeholder="Her satıra bir görsel bağlantısı">'
  +esc((v||[]).join('\n'))+'</textarea>';
 return '<input '+ad+' value="'+esc(v==null?'':v)+'"'+ph+'>'}
function icForm(t,r){r=r||{};
 return '<form id="icf" data-t="'+esc(t.id)+'" data-id="'+esc(r.id||'')+'">'
  +t.fields.map(function(f){
   return '<label class="f">'+esc(f.label)+(f.required?'':' <span class="note">(isteğe bağlı)</span>')
    +icAlan(f,r[f.key])+(f.hint&&f.type!=='imgs'&&f.type!=='text'?'<div class="note" style="margin-top:4px">'+esc(f.hint)+'</div>':'')+'</label>'}).join('')
  +'<div class="row" style="padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)"><div class="t">Sitede görünsün'
  +'<div class="m">Kapatırsanız kayıt durur ama sitede görünmez</div></div>'
  +'<label class="sw2"><input type="checkbox" name="on"'+(r.id?(r.on?' checked':''):' checked')+'><i></i></label></div>'
  +'<div class="mf">'+(r.id?'<button type="button" class="btn" data-a="ic-sil" data-id="'+esc(r.id)+'">Sil</button>':'')
  +'<div class="sp"></div><button type="button" class="btn" data-a="close">Vazgeç</button>'
  +'<button class="btn p">Kaydet</button></div></form>'}
function icVeri(f,t){var d={};
 t.fields.forEach(function(fl){var el=f.elements[fl.key];if(!el)return;
  d[fl.key]=fl.type==='imgs'?el.value.split('\n').map(function(x){return x.trim()}).filter(Boolean):el.value});
 return d}

    async def derive_from_main():
        """ServisPlus'ın kendi PDF notundan şablon üretir: ServisPlus adı/telefonu/adresi yer tutuculara çevrilir."""
        g = await db.main().app_settings.find_one({"_id": "global"}, {"_id": 0}) or {}
        note = (g.get("default_pdf_note") or "").strip()
        if not note:
            return DEFAULT_PDF_NOTE
        for key, ph in (("company_address", "{adres}"), ("company_phone", "{telefon}"), ("company_name", "{firma_adi}")):
            v = (g.get(key) or "").strip()
            if len(v) >= 3:
                note = note.replace(v, ph)
        note = re.sub(r"(?i)\b(?:https?://)?(?:www\.|bayi\.)?servisplus\.net\.tr\S*", "", note)
        note = re.sub(r"(?<![\w.])servis\s*plus(?:\s+usta)?(?![\w.])", "{firma_adi}", note, flags=re.I)
        note = re.sub(r"0?\s?544[\s-]?444[\s-]?4[\s-]?004|0?850[\s\d]{7,10}", "{telefon}", note)
        return re.sub(r"[ \t]{2,}", " ", note).strip()

    async def template():
        d = await db.main().app_settings.find_one({"_id": "firm_defaults"}, {"_id": 0}) or {}

        items = d.get("items")
        if not items:
            return DEFAULT_PACKAGES
        out = {**items, **{k: v for k, v in DEFAULT_PACKAGES.items() if k == "kurumsal" and k not in items}}
        if "kurumsal" in out:                              # Kurumsal paket her zaman tüm modülleri içerir; ek modül yoktur
            out["kurumsal"] = {**out["kurumsal"], "modules": list(ALL_MODS)}

    def clean_modules(v):
        out = ["servis"] + [m for m in (v or []) if m in MODULES and m != "servis"]

    async def resolve_modules(package, modules):

        pk = (await packages_get()).get(package or "")
        if package and not pk:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Bilinmeyen paket")
        return clean_modules((pk or {}).get("modules") or ["servis"])

    _MOD = {}

    async def gate(dbname, path):
        """Firmanın paketinde olmayan modülün API'sini kapatır. Modül listesi 30 sn önbellekte."""
        import time as _t
        e = _MOD.get(dbname)
        if not e or _t.monotonic() - e[0] > 30:
            f = await db.main().firms.find_one({"db": dbname}, {"_id": 0, "modules": 1, "package": 1})
            e = (_t.monotonic(), list(ALL_MODS) if (f or {}).get("package") == "kurumsal" else (f or {}).get("modules"))
            _MOD[dbname] = e
        mods = e[1]
        if mods is None:
            return None                                   # modül tanımı olmayan eski firma: kısıt yok
        seg = path[5:] if path.startswith("/api/") else ""
        eff = set(mods) | ({"randevu"} if "pazarlama" in mods else set()) | ({"magaza", "site"} if "eticaret" in mods else set())   # e-ticaret mağaza uçlarını da açar      # pazarlama paketi online randevuyu da kapsar (eski paketler bozulmaz)
        bk = seg.startswith(("growth/bookings", "growth/settings"))
        for m, pre in MODULE_PREFIX.items():
            if m == "pazarlama" and bk and "randevu" in eff:                    # yalnız Online randevu olan firma randevu ayarlarını ve kayıtlarını yönetebilir
                continue
            if m not in eff and any(seg == p or seg.startswith(p + "/") for p in pre):
                return f"“{MODULES[m]}” bu paketinizde yok. Paket yükseltmek için bizimle iletişime geçin."
        return None

    async def stats_randevu(fdb):
        """Randevuyla çalışan işlerde (kuaför, klinik...) sayılar servis kaydından değil randevu defterinden gelir."""
        by, cust, rev, rev_m, jobs_m, last = {}, set(), 0.0, 0.0, 0, ""
        ay = datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=3))).date().isoformat()[:7]
        for b in await fdb.bookings.find({}, {"_id": 0}).to_list(200000):
            st = b.get("stage") or {"bekliyor": "talep", "onaylandi": "bekliyor", "tamamlandi": "tamamlandi"}.get(b.get("status"), "iptal")
            by[st] = by.get(st, 0) + 1
            if b.get("phone"):
                cust.add(b["phone"])
            last = max(last, str(b.get("created_at") or ""))
            for p in b.get("payments") or []:
                try:
                    a = float(p.get("amount") or 0)
                except (TypeError, ValueError):
                    a = 0.0
                rev += a
                if str(p.get("at") or "")[:7] == ay:
                    rev_m += a
            if st == "tamamlandi" and str(b.get("date") or "")[:7] == ay:
                jobs_m += 1
        done = by.get("tamamlandi", 0)
        return {"by_status": by, "open": by.get("bekliyor", 0) + by.get("talep", 0), "done": done, "total": sum(by.values()), "customers": len(cust),
                "last_activity": last, "revenue_total": round(rev, 2), "revenue_month": round(rev_m, 2), "jobs_month": jobs_m,
                "avg_ticket": round(rev / done, 2) if done else 0, "cancelled": by.get("iptal", 0) + by.get("gelmedi", 0)}

    _STC = {}

    async def stats_cached(f):
        """Firma sayıları 30 sn önbelleklenir; liste her açılışta tüm firmaları yeniden saymasın."""
        c = _STC.get(f["id"])
        if c and time.time() - c[0] < 30:
            return c[1]
        v = await stats(f)
        _STC[f["id"]] = (time.time(), v)
        return v

    async def stats(f):
        fdb = db.firm(f["db"])
        try:
            import sektor_dil
            if sektor_dil.family(f.get("sector") or "") == "randevu":
                return await stats_randevu(fdb)
        except Exception:                                  # noqa: BLE001
            pass
        by = {}
        async for r in fdb.service_jobs.aggregate([{"$group": {"_id": "$status", "n": {"$sum": 1}}}]):
            by[r["_id"] or "yeni"] = r["n"]
        last = await fdb.service_jobs.find({}, {"_id": 0, "updated_at": 1}).sort("updated_at", -1).limit(1).to_list(1)
        open_n = sum(n for s, n in by.items() if s in ("yeni", "atandi", "yolda", "basladi"))
        done_n = sum(n for s, n in by.items() if s in ("tamamlandi", "faturalandi"))
        rp = await build_report(fdb, 2)
        return {"by_status": by, "open": open_n, "done": done_n, "total": sum(by.values()),
                "customers": await fdb.customers.count_documents({}),
                "last_activity": last[0]["updated_at"] if last else "",
                "revenue_total": rp["total"]["revenue"], "revenue_month": rp["current"]["revenue"], "jobs_month": rp["current"]["jobs"],
                "avg_ticket": rp["avg_ticket"], "cancelled": by.get("iptal", 0)}

    @api_router.post("/admin/bulk")
    async def bulk_action(body: dict, me: dict = Depends(require_admin)):
        """Birden çok firmaya aynı anda: paket, modül aç/kapat, süre uzat, askıya al / aç."""
        need_main()
        ids = [str(x) for x in (body.get("ids") or [])][:500]
        act, val = body.get("action"), body.get("value")
        if not ids:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Firma seçin")
        if act not in ("package", "module_on", "module_off", "extend", "status"):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Geçersiz işlem")
        if act in ("module_on", "module_off") and val not in MODULES:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Geçersiz modül")
        if act == "status" and val not in ("aktif", "askida"):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Geçersiz durum")
        try:
            days = int(val) if act == "extend" else 0
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Gün sayı olmalı")
        if act == "extend" and not 0 < days <= 3650:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Gün 1-3650 arası olmalı")
        n, skipped, now = 0, 0, datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        for fid in ids:
            f = await db.main().firms.find_one({"id": fid}, {"_id": 0})
            if not f:
                skipped += 1
                continue
            upd, uset = {}, {}
            if act == "package":
                upd["package"] = str(val)
                upd["modules"] = await resolve_modules(str(val), None)
            elif act in ("module_on", "module_off"):
                m = set(f.get("modules") or [])
                (m.add if act == "module_on" else m.discard)(val)
                m.add("servis")
                upd["modules"] = clean_modules(list(m))
            elif act == "extend":
                cur = f.get("expires_at") or ""
                base = datetime.fromisoformat(cur) if cur and cur > now.isoformat() else now
                upd["expires_at"] = (base + timedelta(days=days)).isoformat()
                upd["status"] = "aktif"
                uset["is_active"] = True
            else:
                upd["status"] = val
                uset["is_active"] = val == "aktif"
                if val == "askida":
                    uset["tokens_valid_after"] = int(time.time())
            await db.main().firms.update_one({"id": fid}, {"$set": upd})
            if "modules" in upd:
                await sync_shop(f, upd["modules"], f.get("modules"))
            if uset:
                await db.firm(f["db"]).users.update_many({"firm_owner": True}, {"$set": uset})
            n += 1
        _ACC.clear()
        _STC.clear()
        _MOD.clear()
        await audit(me, "TOPLU İŞLEM", f"{act}={val} · {n} firma")
        return {"ok": True, "updated": n, "skipped": skipped}

    async def access_ok(dbname, fu):
        """Firma jetonu geçerli mi: firma silinmemiş, süresi dolmamış, (alt kullanıcıysa) açık olmalı. 30 sn önbellek."""
        import time as _t
        k = (dbname, fu or "")
        e = _ACC.get(k)
        if e and _t.monotonic() - e[0] < 30:
            return e[1]
        f = await db.main().firms.find_one({"db": dbname}, {"_id": 0, "status": 1, "expires_at": 1, "id": 1})
        ok = bool(f) and f.get("status") not in ("silindi", "askida") and not expired(f)

            ok = bool(await db.main().firm_users.find_one({"firm_id": f["id"], "email": fu, "active": {"$ne": False}}, {"_id": 1}))
        _ACC[k] = (_t.monotonic(), ok)
        return ok

    async def build_report(fdb, months=12):
        months = max(1, min(int(months or 12), 36))
        rows = await fdb.service_jobs.find({}, {"_id": 0, "status": 1, "total_amount": 1, "labor_fee": 1, "parts_used": 1, "completed_at": 1,
                                                "updated_at": 1, "created_at": 1, "device_type": 1, "customer_name": 1}).to_list(100000)
        def num(x):
            try:
                return float(x or 0)
            except Exception:                              # noqa: BLE001
                return 0.0
        now = datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=3)))
        keys = []
        y, m = now.year, now.month
        for _ in range(months):
            keys.append("%04d-%02d" % (y, m))
            m -= 1
            if m == 0:
                y, m = y - 1, 12
        keys.reverse()
        by = {k: {"month": k, "jobs": 0, "revenue": 0.0, "parts": 0.0, "labor": 0.0} for k in keys}
        dev, cust = {}, {}
        tot = {"revenue": 0.0, "parts": 0.0, "labor": 0.0, "jobs": 0}
        openn = cancelled = 0
        for j in rows:
            st = j.get("status")
            if st in ("yeni", "atandi", "yolda", "basladi"):
                openn += 1
                continue
            if st == "iptal":
                cancelled += 1
                continue
            if st not in ("tamamlandi", "faturalandi"):
                continue
            parts = sum(num(p.get("qty", 1)) * num(p.get("unit_price")) for p in (j.get("parts_used") or []))
            labor = num(j.get("labor_fee"))
            rev = num(j.get("total_amount")) or (parts + labor)
            tot["revenue"] += rev; tot["parts"] += parts; tot["labor"] += labor; tot["jobs"] += 1
            k = (j.get("completed_at") or j.get("updated_at") or j.get("created_at") or "")[:7]
            if k in by:
                b = by[k]; b["jobs"] += 1; b["revenue"] += rev; b["parts"] += parts; b["labor"] += labor
            d = (j.get("device_type") or "Diğer").strip().title() or "Diğer"
            e = dev.setdefault(d, {"name": d, "jobs": 0, "revenue": 0.0}); e["jobs"] += 1; e["revenue"] += rev
            c = (j.get("customer_name") or "—").strip()
            e2 = cust.setdefault(c, {"name": c, "jobs": 0, "revenue": 0.0}); e2["jobs"] += 1; e2["revenue"] += rev
        ml = list(by.values())
        for b in ml:
            for k2 in ("revenue", "parts", "labor"):
                b[k2] = round(b[k2], 2)
        cur = ml[-1]; prev = ml[-2] if len(ml) > 1 else {"revenue": 0, "jobs": 0}
        chg = round((cur["revenue"] - prev["revenue"]) / prev["revenue"] * 100, 1) if prev["revenue"] else None
        best = max(ml, key=lambda b: b["revenue"]) if ml else None
        return {"months": ml, "current": cur, "previous": prev, "change_pct": chg,
                "total": {k2: (round(v, 2) if isinstance(v, float) else v) for k2, v in tot.items()},
                "avg_ticket": round(tot["revenue"] / tot["jobs"], 2) if tot["jobs"] else 0,
                "open": openn, "cancelled": cancelled, "best_month": best if best and best["revenue"] else None,
                "devices": sorted([dict(v, revenue=round(v["revenue"], 2)) for v in dev.values()], key=lambda x: -x["revenue"])[:6],
                "customers": sorted([dict(v, revenue=round(v["revenue"], 2)) for v in cust.values()], key=lambda x: -x["revenue"])[:5]}

        v = (v or "").strip()[:10]
        if not v and not required:
            return ""
        try:
            datetime.strptime(v, "%Y-%m-%d")
        except ValueError:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=field + " geçersiz (GG.AA.YYYY)")
        return v

    def _amt(v):
        try:
            x = round(float(v), 2)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Tutar geçersiz")
        if not (0 < x < 100000000):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Tutar geçersiz")
        return x

    def _today():
        return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

    def _add_months(d, n):
        y, m, dd = [int(x) for x in d.split("-")]
        t = y * 12 + (m - 1) + int(n)
        y, m = divmod(t, 12)
        m += 1
        import calendar
        return "%04d-%02d-%02d" % (y, m, min(dd, calendar.monthrange(y, m)[1]))

    async def maint_loop():
        """Her saat: bakım günü gelen/geçen kayıtlar için firma sahibine (günde bir kez) bildirim gönderir."""
        import asyncio
        import fieldops
        await asyncio.sleep(90)
        while True:
            try:
                t = _today()
                async for f in db.main().firms.find({"status": {"$nin": ["silindi", "askida"]}}, {"_id": 0, "db": 1, "expires_at": 1}):
                    if expired(f):
                        continue
                    tok = tenant.set_firm(f["db"])
                    try:
                        due = await db.fm_maint.find({"next_date": {"$lte": t}, "notified": {"$ne": t}}, {"_id": 0, "id": 1, "name": 1}).to_list(500)
                        if due:
                            owner = await db.users.find_one({"firm_owner": True}, {"_id": 0, "id": 1})
                            if owner:
                                names = ", ".join(d["name"] for d in due[:3]) + (" +%d" % (len(due) - 3) if len(due) > 3 else "")
                                await fieldops.push_to(db, [owner["id"]], "Kombi bakım zamanı", "%d müşterinin bakımı geldi: %s" % (len(due), names), "/tech")
                            await db.fm_maint.update_many({"id": {"$in": [d["id"] for d in due]}}, {"$set": {"notified": t}})
                    finally:
                        tenant.reset(tok)
            except Exception:                              # noqa: BLE001
                pass
            await asyncio.sleep(3600)

    global MAINT_LOOP
    MAINT_LOOP = maint_loop
